lines: Hey, hey — I want to turn this world upside down somewhere, somehow
Truth is, there's hardly any time for it
Well, well — with that, boys and girls gathered together
And the howling spectacle of triumph began
A genius, inhuman, tyrannical
The worst and best partner there is
A simple, clear-cut idea —
won't you wake me up with it, here?
Now, with this very body, I'll take off the weight
What is it that only you can do?
Don't be here
I don't need any comfort
So this place won't turn to wasteland
Hiding that name, I appeared here
The ones running rampant —
I probe them, gouge them, laugh at them, and weep
Ah, how pathetic
Do whatever you want — nothing but complaints
Deny it, do whatever you like
Blame it on someone else
Ah, it flashes back
The coward in me grows dizzy
My feelings and my guts have both rotted away
I don't want to remember — that one day
Spit it out here, get rid of it
Throw away whatever's useless
Won't you break me, right here?
Now I wait for goodbye, lips pressed shut
If the wound of night, soaked into me, won't heal
Don't let me see your tears
I don't need shame like this
So I won't lose everything
If there's something unchanging here
Before the night breaks
Yes — go on and go, it says
Overflowing, a world of white and black, colorless
No love, nothing at all — smeared with a world of lies
Because the demon in my heart will never forgive me
The shadow stretches long, the sun sinks low
If I'm allowed to meet tomorrow
Would I have been saved?
And still, I —
Now, with this very body, I'll take off the weight
What is it that only you can do?
Don't be here
I don't need any comfort
So this place won't turn to wasteland
Hiding that name, I appeared here
The ones running rampant —
I probe them, gouge them, laugh at them, and weep
Because that small courage burns in my chest
